_doc: Klaviyo native sign-up form presets (built in Klaviyo's form editor, not custom code). Settings use Klaviyo's own options, verified 2026-11-04 on help.klaviyo.com (articles 360026474752, 4413544555547, 4406161800987): form types popup, flyout, full page, embed, banner; timing immediately or based on rules (time delay, scroll depth, page count, exit intent; all-or-any toggle); frequency (days before showing again after close; stop after submit); targeting by audience, URL, UTM, location, device; teaser; multi-step with a success step; elements text, button, image, coupon, SMS disclosure, countdown timer, sign-up counter, review quote; inputs email, phone, radio, multi checkbox, date, dropdown, age gate.

welcome-offer.name: Welcome offer
welcome-offer.use_when: The brand has a real first-order offer
welcome-offer.timing: Based on rules: after 8 seconds OR 40% scroll (any rule)
welcome-offer.frequency: Show again 7 days after close; stop after submit
welcome-offer.targeting: Audience: exclude existing profiles and customers. Device: both, with a mobile variant. URL: exclude /checkout and /cart
welcome-offer.success: Coupon block with the code (static) or a unique Klaviyo coupon, plus a shop button
welcome-offer.teaser: Show after form is closed; label with the offer

newsletter-no-offer.name: Newsletter, no discount
newsletter-no-offer.use_when: The brand does not discount, or content leads
newsletter-no-offer.frequency: Show again 14 days after close; stop after submit
newsletter-no-offer.targeting: Audience: exclude existing profiles. Mobile: dock to bottom

steps.name: Email
components: one line on what they get and how often

newsletter-no-offer.success: Thank-you text and a link to the best guide or collection

exit-intent.name: Exit intent
exit-intent.use_when: A second chance on product and collection pages
exit-intent.timing: Based on rules: exit intent (desktop cursor out; mobile quick upward scroll)
exit-intent.frequency: Show again 10 days after close; stop after submit
exit-intent.targeting: Audience: exclude existing profiles. URL: only /products and /collections

steps.name: Email
components: reason to stay (offer only if real)

exit-intent.success: Coupon block if there is a real offer, else a thank-you and a shop link

sms-two-step.name: Email then SMS
sms-two-step.frequency: Show again 7 days after close; stop after submit

steps.name: SMS
components: headline about texts (what and how often)
SMS disclosure language (required wherever SMS consent is collected)

needs: SMS program set up in Klaviyo
sms-two-step.list: Email list and SMS list (one per step)

birthday-capture.name: Birthday capture
birthday-capture.use_when: After sign-up or on the account page, to feed a birthday flow
birthday-capture.timing: Embeds have no timing or frequency; place it on the page

steps.name: Birthday
components: one line on the birthday gift

birthday-capture.success: Thank-you that says when the gift arrives
needs: a real birthday gift or offer

launch-waitlist.name: Launch or restock waitlist
launch-waitlist.use_when: Before a launch or restock, on a dedicated landing URL
launch-waitlist.targeting: URL: the waitlist landing page only

steps.name: Email
components: countdown timer (only to a real date)

launch-waitlist.success: You are on the list, and when to expect the email
needs: the real launch date, or no countdown
launch-waitlist.list: Waitlist list (send the launch email to it first)

holiday-early-access.name: Holiday or sale early access
holiday-early-access.use_when: Before a real sale or BFCM
holiday-early-access.frequency: Show again 3 days after close; stop after submit
holiday-early-access.targeting: Audience: everyone, including existing profiles (they join the early-access list)
holiday-early-access.teaser: Show before displaying form and after form is closed

preference-quiz.name: Preference quiz
preference-quiz.use_when: Wide catalogs where segmentation pays off
preference-quiz.frequency: Show again 14 days after close; stop after submit
preference-quiz.success: Thank-you and a link to the chosen category
preference-quiz.list: Newsletter; the answer is saved as a profile property for segments
